headline: Fronts Stir as Base Turnover Broadens
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger shows a broader—if uneven—stirring of the front. LinnMercyHex has risen to twenty-two base events in twenty-four hours, with two more in the latest two and accelerating casualty rates; its line remains divided, eleven Colonial bases to none Warden. StonecradleHex has fourteen daily events, five in the latest two hours, and now stands at six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base amid heavy fighting. WeatheredExpanseHex records fourteen events, including three in six hours, while its divided count holds at six Warden to three Colonial. FarranacCoastHex has also turned lively, with three events in two hours and five over the day, leaving nine Colonial bases against two Warden. GutterHex’s five daily events came earlier, and FishermansRowHex has returned to the movement column with two fresh events and four in twenty-four hours. StlicanShelfHex remains a close five-to-four division after four daily events, though no recent turnover is recorded. Elsewhere, most ledgers show little or no base movement.
